before.question: Evaluate (212)3 – (121)3 + (222)3
before.ai_explanation: This appears to be a base-3 arithmetic problem: (212)₃ - (121)₃ + (222)₃ = (1000)₃ when evaluated in base 3.

records.source_repair: Corrected year 1985 to 1986 from the rendered section heading; restored base subscripts; corrected answer B to C.
records.explanation: Convert to base ten: (212)₃ = 2×9 + 1×3 + 2 = 23; (121)₃ = 1×9 + 2×3 + 1 = 16; (222)₃ = 2×9 + 2×3 + 2 = 26. Then 23 − 16 + 26 = 33. Since 33 = 1×27 + 0×9 + 2×3 + 0, the result is (1020)₃, option C. Base three uses only the digits 0, 1 and 2.
